title: Extract bounded post-reply observation lifecycle from ConversationService
requirements: A standalone ObservationDispatcher must own bounded in-memory and durable post-reply observation admission, deduplication, execution, statistics and shutdown.
Group and private events must preserve their scopes; automatic affection observation remains group-only while ordinary observers support both scenes.
ConversationService must delegate post-reply observation state and lifecycle without retaining duplicate queue, worker, dedupe or durable-handler state.
Failures, full queues, cancellation, durable recovery and structured reply drafts must preserve the existing at-most-once and shutdown semantics.
